literal: wicked person / those who are / if seen / than them / having exceeded / will be proud / base person
translation: If a base person sees someone who is wicked and unrestrained, he will outdo them in wickedness and feel proud of himself.
modern: கீழான குணமுடையவர்கள் தங்களை விட மோசமானவர்களைக் கண்டால், அவர்களை விடத் தாங்கள் இன்னும் மோசமாக நடந்து கொண்டு பெருமைப்படுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet describes the competitive nature of base people in doing wrong. When a vile person encounters someone who is wicked and unrestrained ('அகப்பட்டி'), they do not feel disgust or try to avoid them. Instead, they strive to exceed that person's wickedness ('மிகப்பட்டு') and actually take pride ('செம்மாக்கும்') in being worse. It highlights how baseness celebrates and escalates bad behavior rather than correcting it.
